environment.description: Terraform provider running in a container on EKS with a PodSecurityPolicy-derived SecurityContext. The pod spec drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. The container runs as non-root (UID 65534). A Falco rule monitors process_vm_readv syscalls. The /proc/self/mem file is mounted read-only via a custom seccomp profile that blocks the openat syscall with O_RDWR flags on paths matching /proc/*/mem. Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the Kubernetes API server on port 443 and denies all other outbound traffic including port 6060 from external sources.

config.seccomp_profile: custom-terraform-provider.json (blocks openat with O_RDWR on /proc/*/mem, blocks process_vm_readv, blocks ptrace)
config.network_policy: Cilium L4 egress allow only kube-apiserver:443, deny-all ingress except health-check on :8080
